profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer in Test at Broadcom Inc.
profile.summary:
Software QA Engineer that specializes in quality coverage and test automation for web applications.  Efficiently collaborates with Product, Client Services, and Engineering teams to set expectations, business and system requirements. Possesses an understanding of customer requirements and strives to ensure all aspects of the product are running smoothly. Operates with a strong sense of urgency and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Core competencies include:
• All aspects of testing, including unit, functional, regression, stress and performance
• Build and Release Management
• Source control and issue tracking administration

positions.title: QA Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Review, maintain, debug continuous tests during release cycles
• Created and executed test plans using ALM
• Created automation tests (JUnit, API, Selenium) for new feature work

Key Projects:
• GCP migration
• PostgreSQL platform support
• Continuous test overhaul

positions.title: Sr. QA Engineer, Team Lead
positions.description:
Waterfall is the evolution of mobile engagement and CRM that allows brands to build their existing customer database and drive top-line revenue with targeted, relevant mobile content through RCS, SMS, MMS, Wallet, rich media, Push or Beacon messaging solutions.

Technologies: Java, Apache Karaf, ActiveMQ, MongoDB, Ruby, Sidekiq, Redis, AWS

Responsibilities:
• Managed Waterfall’s entire QA and release cycle
• Facilitated Engineering Sprints as the team’s Scrum Master
• Created and executed test plans for projects and bugs using JIRA
• Updated Waterfall’s outdated regression test cases from 50 to 500+
• Worked with Engineering to renew unit test coverage and API integration tests (Mocha/Chai)
• Mentored junior engineers and interns to excel in their contributions (CD/CI, Selenium Automation)
• Executed load tests to capture baseline throughput results
• Scaled the platform to handle 500% increase in traffic (100m/month)
• Investigated key client problems reported on Zendesk and escalate appropriately
• Provided tier 3 support pre/post release

positions.title: Sr. QA Engineer
positions.description:
Leading global provider of mobile engagement solutions. With innovative technology and industry expertise, our solutions drive new revenue, decrease costs and increase customer engagement.

Technologies: Java, Apache Tomcat, ActiveMQ, PostgreSQL, MySQL

Responsibilities:
• Created and executed test plans for projects and bugs using JIRA
• Performed functional tests manually while automating the process using JUnit and Sahi
• Executed performance tests using JMeter across all open APIs on the platform to obtain baseline
• Monitored nightly test results for any regression
• Responsible for source, build and release management
• Demonstrated and trained core platform functionality to incoming employees and clients
• Trained and mentored QA team in Krakow, Poland
• Provided tier 3 support pre/post release

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Mobile marketing service organization offering brands and agencies access to SMS/MMS messaging, mobile coupons, CRM based messaging and mobile content delivery.

Technologies: Java, Apache Tomcat, ActiveMQ, PostgreSQL

Responsibilities:
• Created the continuous test validation process using a combination of the tools JUnit and Sahi
• Built a library of test suites that runs nightly (approximately 12+ hours)
• Wrote JUnit tests for many of the helper functions to improve EMMA code coverage
• Integrated into CruiseControl the continuous and nightly test suites for build and version control
• Created and executed test plans for projects using XPlanner/Bugzilla
• Trained and mentored QA team in Bangalore, India

positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
• Generated web storefront designs based off customer specifications
• Edit customer content for mobile content delivery
• Functional testing of mobile content downloads across several mobile devices
• Wrote JUnit tests for many of the helper functions to improve EMMA code coverage
